data.title: The Dubai Beach EDITION
data.about:
Owned by Shamal Holding in partnership with Marriott International, The Dubai Beach EDITION begins a new chapter of luxury at Dubai Harbour. The only EDITION with its own private beach, located just moments from JBR, the four towers showcase the brand’s signature blend of refined design and exceptional service.

This mixed-use waterfront development will include both EDITION residences and a five-star EDITION hotel, together creating a seamless blend of home and hospitality.  

The Residences at The Dubai Beach EDITION will be developed by H&H Development and feature 165 exclusive units, including 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom apartments. The full-service apartments range from 134 to 223 square metres, boasting breathtaking sea views. 

The adjoining hotel will comprise 185 rooms and suites, curated dining concepts, and resort amenities that complement the brand’s contemporary luxury ethos.

characteristics_module.title: The First-Ever EDITION Residences in the Middle East
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Debut of EDITION Residences in the Region - This branded project sets a new benchmark for branded luxury living in Dubai.
  • The Power of a Global Brand - Backed by Marriott International’s hospitality excellence and Shamal Holding’s local vision, The Residences at The Dubai Beach EDITION carries global credibility and investor confidence.
  • Boutique-Style Limited-Edition Apartments - Each of the 165 EDITION luxury apartments is crafted with bespoke finishes, offering intimate sophistication and uninterrupted sea views.
  • Elevated Resort Lifestyle - Residents will enjoy resort-inspired facilities, fine dining, and private beach access.
  • Prime Dubai Harbour Address - Situated between Bluewaters Island and the Palm Jumeirah, the development embodies the essence of seaside exclusivity, connecting residents to the city’s most dynamic waterfront community.
  • Seamless Hotel-Residential Integration - Blending residential privacy with hotel-grade service, The Dubai Beach EDITION offers homeowners the rare comfort of five-star hospitality within their own space.
  • Secure, High-Growth Investment - With completion expected in 2029, this EDITION real estate project promises sustainable long-term growth driven by Dubai’s expanding luxury property market.

location_tile.title: Dubai Harbour: Dubai's Most Iconic Waterfront Address
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located at Dubai Harbour between Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, The Dubai Beach EDITION occupies one of the city’s most exclusive coastal destinations. This vibrant district seamlessly connects luxury residences, retail, and hospitality in a master-planned maritime setting. With its private beachfront, world-class marina, and proximity to landmarks like Dubai Marina, residents enjoy an address that embodies both leisure and connectivity.

  • 5 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 5 minutes to Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR)
  • 9 minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
  • 10 minutes to Dubai Marina Yacht Club
  • 12 minutes to Bluewaters Island
